Adroit for Ekushey
2017-02-14T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/adroit-ekushey-1360039

To mark the occasion of Ekushey, Adroit has brought out a new collection. The line includes clothes for both adults and children. The collection includes saris, panjabis, shalwar kameez sets, fatuas, t-shirts, etc. which all feature Ekushey related motifs. Colours given precedence in this collection include white, off-white, black, and red.

For more information, please call 01190476831.
